detail.longDescription: There are project management platforms, which should make possible at the same time that you can let run a LLM of your own choice over all tickets, documents, conversations, meetings, emails and so on that have to do with a project. I know that there are already such systems and that somehow every third person is building on it. So far so good. I ask myself only where probably the development will go to. The users of course still access the frontend and operate it like you actually always operated it but for developers this often does not apply because they only move around in the cloud console. What do you mean how one will work with such systems in the future? Because also in future you will still work with other humans and maybe you do not want to offer your complete project contents to a provider like OpenAI, because they will surely also offers such systems. But the question is if you really want to throw everything in there and the question is if you really want it that all your data are at one of the big AI provider. If it is now Google, OpenAI or Anthropic.
